title: Add or remove a category on a property certificate of registration
summary: Learn how to add or remove a category on your property certificate of registration.
intro:
If you hold a property certificate of registration, you can add another category of work if you have completed the required qualifications. You can also remove a category.

If your certificate number:

To check your registration details visit Verify NSW.

If you no longer need it you can surrender your certificate.
who_can_apply: You must hold a property certificate of registration.
You must have completed the required qualifications to add a category.
what_you_need: Copies of your qualifications in PDF, JPG, or PNG format

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to add or remove a category.
Download the form Add or Remove a Category Application – PDF.
Complete the form and submit your application:

faqs.q: How do I check my current registration details?
faqs.a: You can check your registration details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What should I do if I no longer need my certificate?
What do I need to apply to add or remove a category?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your certificate number, copies of your qualifications (PDF, JPG, or PNG format), and payment (if adding a category).
